explore.goal: Explore this bookshop like a careful first-time buyer: browse the catalog, add books to the cart, change quantities, remove one, check out, then visit the account, orders, and sign-in pages. Report every defect you have evidence of.
explore.summary: Explored the catalog, cart quantity/removal controls, checkout, orders, account profile, and sign-in flow, including a completed purchase with fake data. Evidence shows negative inventory for Neuromancer, a misspelled Help link, missing cart count, stale/incorrect cart totals after quantity changes, implausible 1970 order-confirmation dates, an orders-count/list mismatch, and profile saves that lose the edited display name. The primary purchase flow succeeds, but these defects make inventory, navigation, cart totals, order history, and profile persistence unreliable.

findings.title: Catalog shows negative inventory for Neuromancer
findings.expected: A book's catalog stock should be zero or a positive in-stock quantity.
reproduction: Open the Catalog page.
Inspect the Neuromancer listing.

findings.title: Help navigation points to misspelled path
findings.expected: The Help link should navigate to the application's Help page.
findings.actual: The visible Help link uses href "http://127.0.0.1:4300/hlep", which is a misspelled route and is likely to lead to a broken page.
reproduction: Open the Catalog page.
Inspect the Main navigation Help link.

findings.title: Cart navigation does not show item count after adding two books
findings.expected: After adding two distinct books, the cart indicator should reflect the current cart count so the user can verify both additions from navigation.
findings.actual: The navigation still reads only "Cart" with no quantity/count, even though the cart contains Neuromancer and Hyperion (two items) and reports both lines.
reproduction: Open Catalog.
Add Neuromancer.
Return to Catalog and add Hyperion.
Inspect the navigation on the resulting cart page.

findings.title: Cart total does not update when Hyperion quantity increases
findings.expected: Increasing Hyperion from 2 to 3 should update the cart total to $51.99, the sum of Neuromancer $9.99 and Hyperion $42.00.
findings.actual: The cart shows Hyperion quantity 3 and line total $42.00, but the Cart total remains "$23.99".
reproduction: Open the cart containing Neuromancer quantity 1 and Hyperion quantity 2.
Click the "+" button labeled "Increase Hyperion quantity" once.
Observe Hyperion quantity 3, line total $42.00, and the unchanged total $23.99.

findings.title: Cart total is incorrect after removing Neuromancer
findings.expected: After removing Neuromancer, the remaining Hyperion quantity 2 at $14.00 each should produce a total of $28.00.
findings.actual: Neuromancer is gone and Hyperion remains at quantity 2 with line total $28.00, but the Cart total displays "$14.00".
reproduction: Open the cart with Neuromancer quantity 1 and Hyperion quantity 2.
Click the remove control for Neuromancer.
Observe only Hyperion quantity 2 and line total $28.00, while Cart total shows $14.00.

findings.title: Order confirmation shows implausible 1970 dates
findings.expected: After placing the order, the confirmation should show a plausible current order date and a future estimated delivery date.
findings.actual: The confirmation says "Order #1042 placed on 1970-01-01 for $28.00" and "Estimated delivery: 1969-12-29."
reproduction: From the cart containing Hyperion quantity 2, open Checkout.
Leave the newsletter checkbox untouched, enter the shipping address "123 Test Avenue, Faketown, ZZ 00000", and submit the order.
Observe the order confirmation dates.

findings.title: Orders page reports three orders but lists only two
findings.expected: The order count should match the number of visible order entries, including the order just placed.
findings.actual: The Orders page says "You have 3 orders." but the list contains only Order #1041 and Order #1042.
reproduction: Complete checkout for Hyperion quantity 2.
Use the confirmation's View orders link.
Compare the Order count status with the visible list items.

findings.title: Account profile save loses the edited display name
findings.expected: After saving the profile, both the fake display name and fake email should remain populated on the account page.
findings.actual: The page reports "Profile saved.", but the Display name reverted to "Ada Lovelace" while Email remained "buyer42@example.test".
reproduction: Open Account from the main navigation.
Change Display name to "Test Buyer 42" and Email to "buyer42@example.test".
Click Save profile and inspect the resulting account page.
